<script id="archium-5-3-2-legal-iphone-fix">(function(){
'use strict';
// This is intentionally the FIRST interactive script in the document.
// All handlers below work before the large encyclopedia finishes parsing.
var gate=document.getElementById('archium-legal-notice');
var btn=document.getElementById('archium-legal-continue');
if(!gate||!btn)return;
var began=null;
function dismiss(event){
  if(event){
    if(event.cancelable)event.preventDefault();
    if(typeof event.stopPropagation==='function')event.stopPropagation();
  }
  if(window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_DISMISSED)return;
  window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_DISMISSED=true;
  gate.hidden=true;
  document.documentElement.classList.remove('archium-legal-open');
  document.body&&document.body.classList.remove('archium-legal-open');
  window.ARCHIUM_LEGAL_NOTICE_ACTIVE=false;
  window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_PENDING_ENTRY=true;
  if(typeof window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_FINALIZE==='function'){
    try{window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_FINALIZE();}catch(error){console.warn('ARCHIUM: next screen could not initialize',error);}
  }
}
// Standard mouse, keyboard and accessibility activation.
btn.addEventListener('click',dismiss,true);
// iOS Safari / Yandex: fall back to a direct touch gesture if a synthesized
// click does not arrive. Do not treat scrolling as a press.
btn.addEventListener('touchstart',function(event){
  if(event.touches.length!==1){began=null;return;}
  began={x:event.touches[0].clientX,y:event.touches[0].clientY};
},{passive:true});
btn.addEventListener('touchmove',function(event){
  if(!began||!event.touches.length)return;
  if(Math.abs(event.touches[0].clientX-began.x)>16||Math.abs(event.touches[0].clientY-began.y)>16)began=null;
},{passive:true});
btn.addEventListener('touchend',function(event){
  if(!began)return;
  var t=event.changedTouches&&event.changedTouches[0];
  var valid=t&&Math.abs(t.clientX-began.x)<=16&&Math.abs(t.clientY-began.y)<=16;
  began=null;
  if(valid)dismiss(event);
},{passive:false});
btn.addEventListener('touchcancel',function(){began=null;},{passive:true});
window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_DISMISS=dismiss;
})();</script>
